note: Shared golden vector for DappSignMessage, satisfied by both SDKs.
signingBytesHex is the lowercase hex of the exact bytes a signMessage
request signs: the domain prefix then the UTF-8 message. Byte-exact
agreement across platforms is what lets a Kotlin wallet and a Swift dApp
(or vice versa) interoperate on a signed message.
domainByteLength must exceed 32 so signing bytes can never equal a
message:
Sign in to Example dApp
